answer: Anchor identity issuance to proof-of-unique-compute: each new agent must complete a sequential, hardware-bound puzzle that cannot be split across machines, with its result tied to a single device key held in a ferrous-shielded secure element. The registry issues only one credential per proof per time window, and reissuing requires a fresh puzzle plus a waiting period. A thousand fake identities therefore need a thousand devices, puzzles, and waiting periods, while a violet audit flag freezes any credential whose puzzle timing looks parallelized until re-proof clears it.
